memory_candidates.content: In this repo, the repo-root CLAUDE.md is intentionally excluded from git tracking via a pre-existing `**/CLAUDE.md` rule in .gitignore (predates any task work, confirmed via `git log --all -- CLAUDE.md` returning no history). Edits to it land on disk but never appear in a git diff or commit — this is expected, not a bug, and should not be 'fixed' by force-adding the file.

When a documentation-refresh plan lists specific defects (e.g. 'dead link X', 'stale quick-start Y') that were identified by an earlier research pass, always re-verify each defect against current disk state before editing — in this task two of the plan's anticipated defects (a jupyter README link and a QUANTIFIER_SOLVERS.md link) had already been resolved by concurrent/prior work, and editing them again would have been wasted or incorrect effort. Verify-then-record is cheaper than blind re-fix.
